question: “Losar” is celebrated as New year festival in Sikkim. It is celebrated on the first day of the first month of the ______ lunar calender.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tibetan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Losar** is celebrated as the **New Year festival in Sikkim.**
 
• It is celebrated on the** first day of the first month** of the Tibetan lunar calendar.
 
• Losar is one of the most important festivals in Sikkim and is celebrated with great** enthusiasm and joy.**
 
• The celebrations usually last for** three days** and involve various rituals, prayers, and offerings.
 
• The festival is also celebrated in other parts of the** Himalayan region, including Tibet, Bhutan, and Nepal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Islamic lunar calendar **is based on the phases of the moon and consists of 12 months. The first month of the Islamic calendar is Muharram, and the New Year is celebrated on the first day of this month.
 
• **Gregorian calendar **is a solar calendar that is widely used around the world. The New Year is celebrated on January 1st.
 
• **Persian calendar**, also known as the Solar Hijri calendar, is a solar calendar used in Iran and Afghanistan. The New Year is celebrated on the first day of spring, which usually falls on March 20th or 21st.

***Hence, the correct answer is option 1.***
